nina: quick heads-up  noticed p99 spikes (~2-5s) when host staging runs. pattern: many tenants trigger demotes, compaction workers get flooded, tiny serial compactions follow.

mira: can you outline a light-weight mitigation idea?

nina: proposing a graded offload controller: (1) compute an "evict_pressure" scalar using smoothed queue_len and resident_score delta, (2) map it to a demote_rate via a sigmoid, (3) bill demotes against per-tenant soft credits (size-weighted). emergency bypass if free_pages_pct < 5%.

leo: sounds reasonable. couple ops asks: telemetry for evict_pressure/demote_rate/credits_denied, a host_penalty emitted for routing if host is constrained, and a safe feature-flag rollout.

ops-bot: note: host-2 free_pages_pct=4.9% p95=410ms

mira: add unit tests for the mapping and a 5-host pilot. nina open PR w/ config, metrics, and a short SRE playbook.

nina: on it, tagging @leo for compaction coalescing review. :thumbsup:
